title: W3Schools: Case-Insensitive Substring Search
description: Given `main_str` and `sub_str`, return `True` if `sub_str` is a substring of `main_str` (case-insensitive), else `False`.
constraints:
0 <= len(main_str), len(sub_str) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def has_substring(main_str: str, sub_str: str) -> bool:
    pass
solution:
def has_substring(main_str: str, sub_str: str) -> bool:
    return sub_str.lower() in main_str.lower()
explanation: Lowercases strings and checks containment in O(N) time.
